description: This source file defines a class RolesStep that handles a recipe step for creating and updating roles, including managing permissions, within the OrchardCore framework. It also includes related models and an enum for permission behaviors.

classes.name: RolesStep
classes.description: Handles the execution of a recipe step to create or update roles with specified permissions.

classes.name: RolesStepModel
classes.description: Model representing a collection of roles for the recipe step.

classes.name: RolesStepRoleModel
classes.description: Model representing individual role details including name, description, permissions, and permission behavior.

classes.name: PermissionBehavior
classes.description: Enum defining behaviors for permission management: Replace, Add, Remove.

methods.name: RolesStep
methods.description: Constructor initializing role manager and system role provider.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the recipe step to create or update roles and manage permissions.
